description: This file defines the SocketsTrace class implementing ISocketsTrace interface, providing logging functionalities for socket connection events such as read, write, reset, pause, resume, and errors, using Microsoft's ILogger.

classes.name: SocketsTrace
classes.description: Implements socket event logging based on the ISocketsTrace interface, wrapping an ILogger instance for logging socket connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: ConnectionRead
methods.description: Logs a socket connection read event (currently disabled for verbosity).

methods.name: ConnectionReadFin
methods.description: Logs that the connection received a FIN signal.

methods.name: ConnectionWriteFin
methods.description: Logs that the connection is sending a FIN signal with an optional reason.

methods.name: ConnectionWrite
methods.description: Logs a socket write event (currently disabled for verbosity).

methods.name: ConnectionWriteCallback
methods.description: Logs a callback after a socket write (currently disabled for verbosity).

methods.name: ConnectionError
methods.description: Logs a connection error with associated exception.

methods.name: ConnectionReset
methods.description: Logs that a connection has been reset.

methods.name: ConnectionPause
methods.description: Logs that a connection has been paused.

methods.name: ConnectionResume
methods.description: Logs that a connection has been resumed.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific log level is enabled.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with specified log level, event ID, state, exception, and formatter.
